morphology.pattern_note: 词根是 rahmat；meN- 在 r 前实现为 me-，保留 r，末尾加 -i。输入包将整词判为词根，此处依 DBP 的 rahmat 派生词记录修正。

senses.zh_definition: 怜悯、体恤某人或其他生命。
senses.en_definition: To show mercy or compassion to someone or another living being.
senses.nuances: 对应 [Kamus Dewan 的第一义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=rahmat)。常见于宗教劝诫和较庄重的文字；施事也可以是人。日常表达关心时，mengasihani、menyayangi 或 membantu 须按具体意思选择。

collocations.en: show compassion to fellow human beings
show mercy to creatures on earth

senses.zh_definition: 赐予恩典、福佑或恩惠，尤指真主施恩于人。
senses.en_definition: To bless or bestow grace or favour upon someone, especially of God.
senses.nuances: 对应 [Kamus Dewan 的第二义](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=rahmat)。常用于 Semoga Allah merahmati ... 的祈愿句；可以祝福在世者，不专用于悼念。

collocations.en: may Allah bless him or her

dual_scenarios.context: 公文 / 新闻 / 职场汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Dalam ucapan penutupnya, pengerusi mendoakan agar Allah merahmati semua petugas dan keluarga mereka.
dual_scenarios.zh: 主席在闭幕致辞中祈愿真主赐福于所有工作人员及其家属。
dual_scenarios.en: In his closing address, the chair prayed that Allah would bless all personnel and their families.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Semoga Allah merahmati kau sekeluarga, ya. Terima kasih sebab dah tolong kami.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Semoga Allah merahmati kamu sekeluarga. Terima kasih kerana sudah membantu kami.
dual_scenarios.zh: 愿真主赐福你们全家啊，谢谢你帮了我们。
dual_scenarios.en: May Allah bless you and your family. Thanks for helping us.
spoken_features: sebab：口语中引出感谢的原因

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Terima kasih sebab dah tolong mak aku tadi. Semoga Allah merahmati kau sekeluarga.
messages.ms_standard: Terima kasih kerana sudah membantu ibu saya tadi. Semoga Allah merahmati kamu sekeluarga.
messages.zh: 谢谢你刚才帮了我妈妈。愿真主赐福你们全家。
messages.en: Thanks for helping my mum earlier. May Allah bless you and your family.

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Amin, sama-sama. Aku tolong sikit je.
messages.ms_standard: Amin, sama-sama. Saya hanya membantu sedikit.
messages.zh: 阿敏，不客气，我只是帮了点小忙。
messages.en: Amen, you're welcome. I only helped a little.

etymology.historical_story: The base rahmat is an Arabic loan associated with mercy and divine favour. Malay combines this borrowed noun with its own verbal affixes to form merahmati. The word therefore connects Arabic religious vocabulary with Malay grammar, while retaining both compassion and blessing as established meanings. See [DBP's rahmat entry](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=243192&keyword=rahmat).
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 抓住中间的 rahmat“恩典”：me- + rahmat + -i，把“恩典”变成“向某人施恩、赐福”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 祝祷时使用 Semoga Allah merahmati tuan/puan 或姓名，比对不熟悉的人使用 kau 更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 适合伊斯兰祈愿、致谢、讲道及庄重祝福。面对宗教背景不明的对象，可依关系选择一般祝福，如 Semoga sentiasa sejahtera。
